messages.text: okay so the magic miner will pool mine too?

Yes. The Magic Miner 40T runs Harlo OS, and Harlo OS takes a stratum pool URL, worker and password right in the settings. So you can point it at any pool you like.

The listing says "mining mode: solo" — that's just how it ships by default, not a limit.

Anything specific you're planning to point it at?

Magic Miner 40T is $799, Batch 5, ships November 14. It's 40 TH/s at ~650W, tunable 30 to 50, so it's far better value per terahash than the S1, which is out of stock right now anyway with batch 2 still in transit.

On the discount, that's Georges and Abel's call, not mine. They've been pinged and will pick it up right here, so stay in the chat and they'll confirm.

Depends what you care about. The B30 is $899 for 30 TH/s at 360 to 450W, ships October 30. The 40T is $799 for 40 TH/s, but ~650W at that speed, and ships November 14.

More hash for less money on the 40T, cheaper to run on the B30. If power is pricey where you are, a second B30 is the safer pick. Where's it running?
i have 2 b30's on order and power is pricy here in fl
Ran the power-cost calculator

I ran these for Florida, at about 15.5 cents a kWh.

A third B30 stacks ~43,100 sats a month, about $36 at today's price, against $45.80 of power. Break-even BTC price is $106,231.

The 40T stacks ~57,500 sats, about $48, but burns $73.50 of power. Break-even $127,870.

At Florida rates the B30 is clearly the better call. Neither turns a profit today, it's sats and the jackpot shot, roughly 1 in 220,000 a day per unit. Today's estimate, prices move.
well the b30 is now 100 more

Right, $899 against $799 upfront. But it costs about $27.70 a month less to run in Florida, so that $100 is back in under four months and it keeps saving after that.

The 40T only wins if power is cheap. Yours isn't.

Georges is still picking up the discount side, and that would apply either way.
cool well if i get a 3rd b30, when would the 3rd one ship?
